Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.mcp

Interface McpServerCatalog

All Known Implementing Classes:
McpServerCatalogAdapter
public interface McpServerCatalog
Read-only port over the configured MCP-server catalog (design §14, REQ-MCP-001 / -006).

The catalog is populated once at application startup by McpServerCatalogAdapter (US-08-003) from the spring.ai.mcp.client.stdio.connections.* configuration tree, then cached for the lifetime of the JVM. Implementations MUST be thread-safe — all() returns an unmodifiable snapshot.
